subject: [PATCH 19/22] mm/migrate: restrict move_pages() destinations to common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch restricts the destination of the move_pages() function to common memory, rejecting any node without common memory. This change aligns with how memory policies work and ensures that user memory is placed on a general-purpose node. Currently, all memory is considered common, so this patch does not introduce any behavioral changes.
